subject: gk
question: Which of the following is NOT correct regarding the Pacific Ocean?

options.text: Asia, Australia, North and South Americas surround it
The Pacific Ocean is perfectly oval in shape.
The Pacific Ocean is the largest ocean.
Mariana Trench, the deepest part of the earth, lies in the Pacific Ocean.

solution:
The correct answer is __**The Pacific Ocean is perfectly oval in shape.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ocean**:-

 
 
• The ocean is the body of salt water that covers approximately 70.8% of the surface of Earth.
 
• It contains **97% of Earth's water. **
 
 
 
• **Pacific Ocean:-****​**
 
 
• It is the largest and deepest ocean in the world. **(Hence statement III is correct)**
 
• Most of the islands of this ocean are volcanic or of coral origin.
 
• Mariana Trench is the deepest trench of the world, lies in there. **(Hence statement IV is correct)**
 
• The depth of this trench is 11033 m.
 
• It is surrounded by Asia, Australia, North and South America**. (Hence statement I is correct)**
 
• It starts from the Arctic ocean in the North to the Southern Ocean in the South. 
 
• It is spread over one-third of the earth.
 
• The Pacific Ocean is almost circular in shape. **(Hence statement II is incorrect)**
 
• The Arctic ocean is connected with the Pacific Ocean by a narrow stretch of shallow water known as Berring strait.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Atlantic Ocean:**

 
 
• The Atlantic Ocean is the second-largest ocean in the world.
 
• It is S-shaped.
 
• It is flanked by the North and South Americas on the western side, and Europe and Africa on the eastern side.
 
• The coastline of the Atlantic Ocean is highly indented.
 
• This irregular and indented coastline provide an ideal location for natural harbours and ports.
 
• From the point of view of commerce, it is the busiest Ocean.
 
 
 
• 
 
Indian Ocean:

 
 
• The Indian Ocean is the only ocean named after a country, that is, India.
 
• The shape of the ocean is almost triangular.
 
• In the north, it is bound by Asia, in the west by Africa and in the east by Australia.
 
• The Southern Ocean encircles the continent of Antarctica and extends northward to 60 degrees south latitude.
 
 
 
• Arctic Ocean:
 
 
• ​The Arctic Ocean is located within the Arctic Circle and surrounds the North Pole.
 
• It is connected with the Pacific Ocean by a narrow stretch of shallow water known as Berring strait.
 
• It is bound by the northern coasts of North America and Eurasia
